about: Figma source of truth for Game Core Style 2 (READY_UI_STYLE_2, id style-2): the Confirm window (ConfirmWindowView), Restart and Exit. Read 2026-10-02 through the Figma MCP: get_metadata, read-only use_figma dumps, get_screenshot (screens and the modal groups, contentsOnly). Coordinates are Figma units of the 1080 x 2344 screen frame; the window boxes are local to the window box (60, 675).

snapshot.label: provisional approved snapshot
snapshot.note: The artist is still working on Style 2: this is the approved state the current implementation follows, not a frozen style. To see what changed: re-read the node ids below (boxes, fills, text styles, main component keys) and re-render the screens / the modal groups, then diff against reference/ and against Style 1's docs/figma/confirm-exit/reference (see README.md).
